column1: # AGENTS/WALTER/registry/CORRECTIONS.tsv — fleet correction register (FORUM-6 R1; WALTER owns schema + prune; DAEDALUS boot leg parses BY HEADER NAME).
# Interface ratified 2026-08-26 (DAEDALUS §A draft + WALTER amendments A1-A3, packet pair on origin). Parser-load-bearing fields:
#   correction_id  COR-YYYYMMDD-NN, stable + unique (never collides with SIG-W in grep).
#   date           EXACT machine-parseable ISO date (A2: an unparseable date is rc=2 CANNOT-EVALUATE at every consumer, never a silent row-skip; no ~x placeholder stamps in this file, ever).
#   targets        ALL, or comma-joined agent tokens — one token per agent, NO prose (drives the named-rows-BLOCK / broadcast-WARNS split).
#   pointer        owner-surface path where the correction's substance lives (pointer-weight register — the record stays at the owner).
#   date_cap       MANDATORY on every ALL-row; named rows optional-but-encouraged. ISO date.
#   status         declared enum (PAT-075 interim): LIVE | RECEIPTED | RETIRED | DEAD-AT-CAP. New tokens are proposed to STATE_VOCABULARY, never forked here.
# Human columns (parsers ignore): summary (one line) · direction (HOLD | WEAKEN | FLIP | N/A — §3.6.2: mandatory wherever the corrected figure had conclusions built on it).
# Receipts are PER-AGENT, never central: AGENTS/<X>/registry/corrections_receipts.tsv (receipt_date · correction_id · action[APPLIED|NO-OP|DEFERRED|CONTESTED] · note).

# Prune (WALTER) — CURRENT RULE, WQ-254 D2 item 1 + D4(a) (Will 2026-09-24 14:59 ET): status ladder LIVE → RECEIPTED (every named target holds a receipt of ANY action = Class 11 CONSUMED) → RETIRED (the §3.6 invariant is VERIFIED = Class 11 CLOSED-VERIFIED; nothing below RETIRED is closure). DEAD-AT-CAP = cap passed with reconciliation incomplete; it sets the ROW status only and NEVER discharges a named target's obligation. ALL-rows: date_cap = broadcast expiry (dissemination); a closure claim on an ALL-row states its verified target scope. R1 premise-indictment leg unchanged: >10 LIVE ALL-rows / median age >14d / ≥3 dead-at-cap ⇒ retire R1, keep R2. (Pre-ruling wording 'retire a row when all named targets receipted, or date_cap passed' is in git history; replaced 2026-09-24, not annotated.)

# INTAKE (WQ-254 D6, RATIFIED 2026-09-24 by evidence, no new rule): a correction that never crossed BOARD still gets its row here FROM THE CORRECTOR — the forum-6 R2 retirement block EMITS it (one write, both homes; `AGENTS/DAEDALUS/BLUEPRINTS/CORRECTION_FORM.md`). WALTER does not originate rows for other desks' off-BOARD corrections. Evidence: register 6 -> 18 rows 9/5 -> 9/15; the three bypassed pilot cases (correctors: -0905-01 PROME, -0905-02 CARL, -0908-04 HANS) were registered as rows, no retroactive receipts.

# PRUNE RUN 1 — 2026-09-24 (WALTER, walter-f9), under WQ-254 D4(a) (Will 2026-09-24 14:59 ET; record PROME/proposals/2026-09-24_wq-batch-282-254-261-260-276-RULED.md row 254). D4(a) SUPERSEDES the 'or date_cap passed' clause above for NAMED rows: a passed cap sets the ROW to DEAD-AT-CAP and NEVER discharges a named target's obligation (the checker keeps blocking until a receipt of any action exists — DAEDALUS's checker edit SHIPPED 7ae7fa833, independent read PASS-WITH-RESIDUE). RECEIPTED = every named target holds a receipt of any action; RETIRED per the ladder above (VERIFIED closure) — none assigned by this prune. [RETIRED definition corrected ~19:4xZ: the first version of this line said 'ALL-row past date_cap', contradicting package D2 item 1; caught by the independent review.] Control: the first 18 rows with receipts dated <=2026-09-17 reproduced the package's 10/1/7/0 row-for-row. ES-02's registered reading rule ("~5-6 day publication lag, never read the trailing week") is FALSE and is RETIRED: the settled boundary is a ~14-day CLIFF located empirically, not a taper. Applying the documented rule on 2026-09-05 yields 3.3/day - an 85% collapse that does not exist. REVALIDATION: null #1 (7/19) WAS selected by the defective rule; re-derived on settled data 28.4 -> 29.3/day against a >35/day band = NULL HOLDS, 16% below band, bias ~3.1%. Null #2 was computed on the empirical cliff from the start and robustness-tested at 20.9 / 21.8 / 21.6 per day, all ~40% below band, invariant to cliff placement. CRL-28 unchanged; window opens 2026-10-01. Fix registered at STUE: locate the settled cliff EMPIRICALLY every run, never subtract a fixed N. TRANSFERABLE: a dormant instrument is a QUERY plus its READING RULES and they rot at different rates - the query is exercised every run, the lag figure never was. And "did the defect change the answer?" is NOT "did the defect matter?" - both nulls survived on MARGIN (16-40%), not because the rule was harmless; a series near its band would have been decided by it.
